line.name: Year of the Dragon
line.background_text: Year of the Dragon was Rocky Patel's inaugural entry into a new Chinese Zodiac-themed limited-edition series, released for Chinese New Year 2024 to honor the dragon as a symbol of power, strength, and prosperity. The blend pairs a Mexican San Andres wrapper with dual Honduran/Nicaraguan binders over all-Nicaraguan filler tobacco aged since 2014, produced at Rocky Patel's TAVICUSA factory in Nicaragua. Limited to 6,000 ten-count boxes for the U.S. market with red-and-gold packaging honoring the Chinese New Year aesthetic.

vitolas.summary_review: Cigar Coop rated it 87 points, noting mocha, mineral, vegetal, cherry, and pepper notes but scored it 'not recommended' for value at $35.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Scored 87/100 with mocha, mineral, vegetal, cherry and pepper notes; rated 'not recommended' for value at $35/stick.
